citation: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 11, section 11.3.1 RQI/RPI - request for insurance information (event I01), p 11-10. Triggers Table 0354 v2.4 maps to RPI_I01 that no caption prints, accepted with the printed ones (P8b-11 ruling): RPI^I04. Unprinted group names (ADR-019 decision 3): PROVIDER (HL7-xml v2.4/RPI_I01.xsd, RPI_I01.PROVIDER.CONTENT), GUARANTOR_INSURANCE (HL7-xml v2.4/RPI_I01.xsd, RPI_I01.GUARANTOR_INSURANCE.CONTENT) and INSURANCE (HL7-xml v2.4/RPI_I01.xsd, RPI_I01.INSURANCE.CONTENT).
